text: This report presents a consolidation of the Human Resource Management and Ethical Framework ("Framework") that incorporates past Council decisions. The City Clerk is providing this report to be received for information in response to Council's direction on the Integrity Commissioner's report CC11.2 "Addressing Workplace Harassment and Discrimination" in which the Integrity Commissioner had noted various Council decisions were not reflected in the Framework.
The Executive Committee: 1. Received the report (November 26, 2024) from the City Clerk for information.
